text.tspan: ArgoCD reconciles every namespace from Git; a direct kubectl apply

box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;

div.div:
Per-namespace controls, identical in every environment
• default-deny: no ingress or egress unless an allowance below grants it
• allow-dns: egress to CoreDNS · allow-intra-namespace: traffic between the namespace's own pods · allow-redis: the namespace's services to its own Redis
• allow-load-balancer: the ALB's public subnets to frontend on :8080 · allow-observability-scrape: the observability namespace to the metrics ports, :9114 included · allow-tracing-egress: OTLP to Jaeger on :4317
• ResourceQuota and LimitRange bound CPU, memory and object counts; the Role scopes modification rights to the environment; the SecretStore reads only this environment's secrets through IRSA

text.tspan: Per-namespace controls, identical in every environment
• default-deny: no ingress or egress unless an allowance below grants it
• allow-dns: egress to CoreDNS · allow-intra-namespace: traffic between the namespace's own pods · allow-redis: the namespace's services to its own Redis

• allow-load-balancer: the ALB's public subnets to frontend on :8080 · allow-observability-scrape: the observability namespace to the metrics ports, :9114 included · allow-tracing-egress: OTLP to Jaeger on :4317
• ResourceQuota and LimitRange bound CPU, memory and object counts; the Role scopes modification rights to the environment; the SecretStore reads only this environment's secrets through IRSA
